text:
devin: Heads-up — planning a new GPU node pool in asia-south2 to support bursty embed jobs. Need quick preflight: instance type recommendations, quota callbacks, autoscaler configs, and any networking egress gotchas. Thinking mixed A10G preemptible + a small H100 reserved for low-latency routes.

ben: +1 on preflight. First thing: check per-region GPU quota for both A10G and H100. asia-south2 quotas are tight right now. I can run a quota query. Also cost note: A10G preemptible is ~0.18/hr, H100 reserved is ~3.2/hr — plan for fallback to a10g when reserved H100 saturated.

maria: For the workload, ensure we use node taints + pod tolerations so we don't accidentally schedule low-priority jobs onto H100s. Also set podPriority for realtime jobs so autoscaler will favor bringing reserved nodes up for them.

infra-bot: Quota check results: A10G GPU quota remaining: 12, H100 quota remaining: 2. vCPU soft quota might block scaling above ~48 vCPUs without request. See ticket #INF-4021.

ajay: Re: autoscaler config — we should use cluster-autoscaler with mixed instances and scale-up-with-schedule for predictable morning spikes. Also extend scale-down-unneeded-time to 10m for GPUs to avoid cache churn. Add node-group labels like gpu-type=a10g|h100 and provisioner taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule.

devin: Good call. Maria — can you paste the toleration + priority example?

maria: Sure, tiny example: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: embed-worker
spec:
  priorityClassName: high-embed
  tolerations:
  - key: "gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  nodeSelector:
    gpu-type: a10g
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: redwood/embed-worker:stable
```

ben: Also consider prefix KV cache warmers so when new nodes come up they hit cache ASAP. That reduces H100 time-to-first-token and cost.

sara: FYI — earlier we hit an issue where the amd64 kernel on the asia image didn't have the right NVIDIA driver early on; had to pin to boot-image v202.6. If you plan to use custom node images, test nvidia-container-runtime + driver install in a staging pool.

devin: Noted. Who's owning the quota request for vCPU & GPUs? I'll open the H100 request but need someone to file the A10G vCPU soft-limit bump.

ben: I'll take A10G quota request. Filing after we finalize node pool size. Propose initial pool: a10g-preemptible: min 0, max 12 (gives burst), h100-reserved: min 1, max 3. Autoscaler profile: balance-similar-node-groups, scale-down-unneeded-time: 10m, expander: least-waste.

maria: One more ops constraint: set eviction grace period 6m and enable PodDisruptionBudgets for critical controllers. Also add a node-termination-handler for preemptible nodes to drain with a 2m window.

ajay: Networking: ensure egress NAT IP capacity in asia-south2 — each nodepool will need egress SNAT capacity for model downloads. If using private registries, pre-pull images via DaemonSet in a small pre-provision pool.

devin: Perfect. Action items: I will open H100 quota request (INF-4028). Ben will file A10G quota + vCPU bump. Maria will add taint/toleration + PDB snippets to the helm chart. Sara will smoke-test driver on staging node image. Ajay will add autoscaler config PR.

ben: I'll also add a cost estimate note to the PR: expected incremental monthly = (avg concurrent H100 hours * 3.2) + (A10G preemptible hours * 0.18) + egress.

infra-bot: Created ticket INF-4028 (H100 quota request) and assigned to devin. Created ticket INF-4031 (A10G vCPU soft-quota) and assigned to ben.

devin: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after quota approvals and the autoscaler PR landing. :thumbsup:
